sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Organization sent two choppers to prevent the Huntik Foundation team from landing in Vienna. Dante Vale and Zhalia Moon stopped them by summonning Metagolem and King Basilisk directly onto the choppers, leading them to crash down. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Another chopper was sent under Wilder's reign to attack the team while they were travelling to Tower of Nostradamus in France. [The Bookshop Hunter]

full_text:
Combat Choppers are large blue military helicopters used by the Organization as their primary aerial vehicle. The choppers are piloted by the Organization Pilots and are heavily armed with missiles which can take down enemy planes.

History

The Organization sent two choppers to prevent the Huntik Foundation team from landing in Vienna. Dante Vale and Zhalia Moon stopped them by summonning Metagolem and King Basilisk directly onto the choppers, leading them to crash down. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Another chopper was sent under Wilder's reign to attack the team while they were travelling to Tower of Nostradamus in France. [The Bookshop Hunter]
